calls.text: {"value": 5, "verdict": "caveat", "caveats": ["liquid_dependent", "single_paper", "not_comparable"], "answer": "Amine-modified polystyrene (PS-NH2) nanoplastics are the polymer group most consistently reported with a positive zeta potential, with reported medians around +5 to +10 mV in water. This value is not robust: zeta potential is highly sensitive to pH, ionic strength, and media composition, and most unmodified polymers (PS, PE, PP, PVC) show negative values instead."
